title: Four-Part Protocol for Enhanced Crop Yield and Nutrition
reason: Explains a four-part protocol for increasing crop yield and brick nutritional value.

tasks.task: Describe the first step of the four-part protocol.

subtasks.text: Mix soluble mineral flakes into irrigation water or center pivot fertilization system in the early growing season.

frames.caption: A sprinkler is spraying water over a grassy field.
A field is being irrigated with a sprinkler system.
A large field with crops and irrigation equipment, with a cloudy sky in the background.

tasks.task: Describe the second step of the four-part protocol.

subtasks.text: Incorporate biologic soil improvement bacteria into irrigation water alongside soluble mineral flakes.

frames.caption: A Reinke irrigation system is spraying water in a field.
A field of young corn plants with some soil and debris.
The video shows a field being irrigated with a sprinkler system.

tasks.task: Explain the third step of the four-part protocol.

subtasks.text: Apply foliar mineral spray to plant leaves or grass, focusing on when many leaves have appeared.

frames.caption: A tractor is spraying a field at night.
A tractor is spraying a field with a sprayer.
A large green agricultural machine is spraying a field.

tasks.task: Describe the fourth and final step of the four-part protocol.

subtasks.text: Use spreadable mineral pellets during the dormant off-season or before planting.
